notes:
SCOPE: this is the Mystic Enchanting panel (Collections -> Mystic Enchants). It is hidden for CoA classes (Collections.lua:78 `if not IsCustomClass()`), so under DESIGN's CoA-first release it only matters for default/Hero characters; still, EnchantCollectionUtil (FrameXML) and MysticEnchantManagerUtil load with FrameXML for everyone and touch natives at load (see below).

ARCHITECTURE: three-pane PortraitFrame parented to Collections: left `Slots` (ECSlotFrameMixin) with three cross-faded sub-tabs -- ReforgeTab (buy/reroll/save scrolls, altar XP bar), SlotTab (the 11/17-slot ring, preset manager), ArchitectTab (Hero Architect enchant list) -- and right `Collection` (ECCollectionFrameMixin) with ScrollsTab (HybridScroll list of scroll items in bags) and CollectionTab (paged grid of 18 collected/uncollected enchants). Overlays: CollectionScrollReforge, NoAltarFrame, InputBlock(+cast Progress), EnchantUnlockPopup, EnchantActivationFrame. All layout is procedural Lua (CreateFrame in :Layout) -- FrameTemplates.xml only declares 7 virtual button/frame templates whose OnLoad calls MixinAndLoadScripts.

SLOT MODEL: UI slot ids are FAKE (1..NUM_MYSTIC_ENCHANT_SLOTS, positioned by EnchantCollectionUtil.slotSettings on two rings; slot 1 legendary, 2-4 epic, 5-7/8-17 generic/rare) and mapped to REAL server slots through EnchantCollectionUtil.slotMap (built in Init from GetAppliedEnchant per slot, persisted per preset in the custom WTF). Every native slot argument (GetAppliedEnchant, CanEquipSlot, ApplySlot, CollectionReforgeSlot, Destroy, Disenchant/UndoApply/UndoCollectionReforge, MYSTIC_ENCHANT_SLOT_UPDATE payload) is the REAL slot; GetFakeSlotID/GetRealSlotID translate. A shim server module needs: applied enchant per real slot per preset, a staging area (ApplySlot/CollectionReforgeSlot are client-side stages read back through GetApplyChanges/GetCollectionReforgeChanges; SaveApply/SaveCollectionReforge commit), and the Can* validation strings.

RESULT/ERROR PROTOCOL: every C_MysticEnchant.Can* returns (ok, errorKey, ...) with globalstring KEYS; keys ending in `_OK` mean success; result EVENTS carry the same key strings ("RE_REFORGE_OK" etc.) and are funnelled through EnchantCollectionMixin:HandleError -> EnchantCollectionUtil:HandleError which prints them via SendSystemMessage + UIErrorsFrame. C_MysticEnchantPreset.Can* instead returns (ok, arrayOfErrorKeys). The five RE_*_NO_MYSTIC_ALTAR keys double as an 'altar closed' signal.

EVENT BUS: the addon never calls Frame:RegisterEvent for custom events except SlotFrameReforgeTab.lua:13 (MYSTIC_ENCHANT_PURCHASE_MYSTIC_EXTRACT_RESULT); everything else is C_Hook (Region:HookEvent -> C_Hook:Register with table-method dispatch `self[event](self, ...)`, bucketed variants deliver (event, {args...})). On Ascension, C_Hook sees native events because HookHandler:RegisterAllEvents() rebroadcasts every frame event. So the shim's Transport `EVENT <name> [args]` must end in `C_Hook:SendEvent(name, ...)`, and DESIGN's metatable RegisterEvent hook must also let HookHandler receive custom names (or simply have ASC.Events.Fire call both). Three events are fired by Lua only (MYSTIC_ENCHANT_SLOT_MAP_REFRESH, ENCHANTCOLLECTION_DIALOGUE_SHOW/HIDE, ENCHANTCOLLECTION_PRESET_SWAP_STARTED, ENCHANTCOLLECTION_LOADED) and two bag events come from a Lua bag-diff (C_InventoryState) over stock BAG_UPDATE/ITEM_PUSH -- nothing to emulate there beyond stock events.

CRITICAL SHIM PATCHES (apply to compat copies, record in client/PATCHES.md): (1) SharedXML/C_Hook.lua `if not issecure()` branches recurse infinitely from insecure code -- strip them; (2) FrameXML/Util/MysticEnchantManagerUtil.lua:143 WritePresets issecure() guard -- strip, else Init() logs an error per load and preset names never persist; (3) provide GetTextureMetatable/GetButtonMetatable/GetCheckButtonMetatable (and the other Get*Metatable used by TypeExtensions) as getmetatable(CreateFrame(type)).__index; (4) PlaySound numeric SoundKit mapping; (5) RegisterCVar the two custom cvars; (6) Ascension_EnchantCollection.toc needs `## Dependencies: Ascension_Collections, AscensionUI` already -- add !AscensionShim per DESIGN.

LOAD-ORDER FACTS: EnchantCollection.lua:54-64 reads ENCHANT_COLLECTION_NEED_MORE_EXTRACTS / _LEVELS globalstrings at file load; OnLoad runs GetSpellInfo over ~260 spell ids; `Timer.After(0.1, EnchantCollectionUtil:Init)` then hits GetActivePreset -> GetNumPresets/GetPresetData, GetAppliedEnchant x slots, GetEnchantInfoBySpell, WriteCustomWTF, and fires MYSTIC_ENCHANT_SLOT_MAP_REFRESH. SetupFilters (Collection OnLoad) iterates C_ClassInfo.GetAllSpecs for the 10 stock class tokens and must not get nil. ECSlotTabMixin:OnLoad creates all slots immediately (GetSlotSettings/GetSlotData/CanEquipSlot). OnShow order: C_CVar.Set, hook 16 events, BAG_UPDATE (scroll list refresh + ReforgeTab Init -> GetReforgeCost/GetMysticScrollCost, Item loads), UpdateProgress (GetProgress), UpdateAltar (HasNearbyMysticAltar + ReforgeTab UpdateButtons), MYSTIC_ENCHANT_PRESET_SET_ACTIVE_RESULT(nil) => UpdateActivePresetButton + EnchantCollectionUtil:Init() AGAIN + PlaySound, then QueryEnchants(1,1,"",{RE_FILTER_KNOWN}) picks the starting Collection tab. So a shim that returns empty-but-well-typed values (QueryEnchants -> {}, 0; GetNumPresets -> 0; GetAppliedEnchant -> 0; GetProgress -> 0, 1; HasNearbyMysticAltar -> false; scroll filter count 0; GetAllSpecs -> {} ) opens the panel in a sane 'no altar / no scrolls' state.

QUIRKS WORTH KNOWING: QueryEnchants' second return is used as a page count AND (with entriesPerPage=1) as the total; filters arrive as either an array or a key->true set; SlotFrameReforgeTab.lua:150 dereferences REData before its nil check; SlotFrameSlotTab.lua:412-418 dereferences REData.MaxStacks after a non-returning nil check; ECReforgeTabMixin:PurchaseExtract and :MYSTIC_ENCHANT_REFORGE_RESULT are dead; two frames share the global name EnchantCollection.CollectionFilter; the SavedVariable Ascension_EnchantCollection_CDB is never written; `C_Player:IsHero()` is called with colon syntax (C_Player is a Lua table, fine).
